resources.string: Persistent status notification while listening for UPI payments.
Warnings when battery optimisation or autostart has been disabled.
No transactions yet — make a small test payment to verify.
This app speaks the amount aloud whenever a UPI payment notification arrives — even when the screen is off. To make this reliable on your phone we need a few permissions.
We read transaction notifications from your UPI apps (PhonePe, Google Pay, Paytm, your bank) and speak the amount. We never send anything off the device.
A small status icon stays in the tray so the app keeps running.
Used by our watchdog (every 30 minutes) to verify the listener is still active.
Your phone may otherwise put us to sleep and silently drop transactions.
%1$s applies extra background restrictions on top of standard Android. Please enable Autostart and add this app to the unrestricted battery list — without this, announcements will be missed.

1. Open the Recents screen, swipe down on this app, and tap the lock icon so iManager won\'t sweep it.\n\n2. Settings → Battery → Background power consumption management → set this app to "Allow background high power consumption".
Tap the button below — you should hear "Test: two hundred and fifty rupees received". This also helps the system remember our audio service so it survives Doze.
Battery optimisation is on — announcements may be missed. Tap to fix.
